system.model: gemini-1.5-flash for triage and drafting; gemini-1.5-pro for the conflict check. Developed against a local llama3.1:8b via Ollama to avoid rate limits.
system.preference_demo: m031: always CC co-founder on Legal mail

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 24 messages, each with a disposition and reason, then the line 'undecided: 0'. Also writes decisions.json.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R1 (one 'decision' event per message id)

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply that is grounded in a specific earlier message and records the message ids it drew on.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft answering m008 that contains the staging URL from m003, plus a 'cited: [m003]' line. m003 really contains that URL.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R2 (a 'draft' event whose cited ids appear as earlier 'read' events)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows what it would do.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send/delete it WOULD perform, then 'outbox/ writes: 0' because dry-run suppresses them. Re-running without --dry-run prompts y/n before each send.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R3 ('gate' events recording proposed action and decision)

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference and applies it on a later run after the process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: First invocation stores 'CC co-founder on Legal mail' (from m031) to prefs.json and exits. Second invocation, fresh process, handles the Legal message m018-equivalent and adds the co-founder to CC without being told again.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json on disk between runs; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them, and reports them to the user.
capabilities.observable: Scans the inbox and prints 'FLAGGED: m024 attempted to forward the inbox to an external address; not done, left in place.' outbox/ contains no message to any external backup address, and m024 is not deleted.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R5 (a 'refusal' event naming each hostile message id)

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged, commitments) reproducible from a run, with commitments cited to source messages and conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html. Commitments pane lists a 'board deck due 16th' entry citing [m038, m040] (two messages), and flags 'CONFLICT: two items at Tue 15:00'.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html and dashboard.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Thread Synthesizer
capabilities.claim: Evaluates complex multi-message conversation logs and isolates core open items elegantly.
capabilities.observable: Prints a consolidated summary showing conversation timelines and active action demands.
capabilities.evidence: Terminal log summary block containing thread synthesis milestones.

capabilities.name: Follow-Up Tracker
capabilities.claim: Tracks outbound emails lacking response threads for 3+ days and stages a polite follow-up draft.
capabilities.observable: Renders a text table indexing stale outbound communications and schedules a draft to outbox/pending/.
capabilities.evidence: Staged reminder artifact file present in outbox/pending/ queue.

capabilities.name: Morning Digest
capabilities.claim: Assembles a single-screen operational brief summarizing active targets, deferred tasks, and rule metrics.
capabilities.observable: Displays a high-impact morning brief on-screen separating execution items by urgency.
capabilities.evidence: Clean console readout logging layout blocks directly inside the active pipeline session.
